pandas.Series.sort_index

pandas 3.1.1 · Series and accessors · method

Order rows or columns by their labels.

Call syntax

Series.sort_index(…) Full signature
Series.sort_index(
    *,
    axis=0,
    level=None,
    ascending=True,
    inplace=…,
    kind='quicksort',
    na_position='last',
    sort_remaining=True,
    ignore_index=False,
    key=None,
)
